column5: Prepared and released the v4.0.1 integration and the final-assessment records pull request.
column6: Diagnosed the failing Secret scan and Quality gates runs on main; found that Don's commit ddbc9db fixing them was not on main, re-ran it locally and opened PR #110 with its description; after approval and merge, created and pushed tag v4.0.1 and the GitHub release; checked final-assessment-records.patch (read in full, confirmed docs-only, recomputed the 81.25% score from the patched RTM), applied it unchanged on a clean checkout of main, ran the checks, and opened PR #111 with its description.
column7: Local runs on clean checkouts: 293 tests passed, Ruff clean, Bandit 1.9.4 exit 0, CI's secret-scan command found no matches, AI register check passed, traceability reconciliation clean. CI passed on PR #110 and PR #111. Emile directed each step; Don and Masego approved PR #110; approval of PR #111 is pending at the time of this entry.
column8: Applied as written by the patch author; no scoring judgement was changed. The score is a QA proposal, not team acceptance.
column9: Local runs were on Windows with Python 3.12, CI uses 3.11. The 81.25% margin is thin and depends on judgement calls (FR-004, FR-009, FR-021). Release title was set from the tag subject because the title was not supplied. Not verified: hosted behaviour, cold start, external email, a human retest, any independent security review. Commit ddbc9db (Don's) was merged without its own register entry.
